name: Checkout Flow Developer
summary: A software developer building or maintaining an e-commerce checkout page, from shipping details through payment.
description: Owns the checkout experience on an e-commerce site or app: collecting and validating a customer's phone number (validation.normalize-phone-number) for shipping/delivery contact, displaying prices correctly formatted for the customer's own locale and currency (formatting.format-currency), and catching an obviously mistyped card number before attempting a doomed charge (validation.validate-luhn). All three concerns live on the same checkout page and are typically owned by the same feature team, even though each is a narrow, separate validation/formatting step.

distinguished_from.how: Works on the purchase/payment flow, which happens after a customer already has an account -- not the account-creation form itself. Different point in the customer lifecycle.
Builds an e-commerce checkout experience, not a note-taking/productivity app -- a completely different product domain.
